entries.changelog: The map's View list shows As-Is, any To-Be scenario, or one map comparing a scenario with As-Is: added and merged-into services in green, re-homed ones purple and dashed, retired and merged-away ones as faded ghosts, with the change in service count and cross-domain connections; scenario views never move saved positions.

entries.changelog: To-Be scenarios record changes over the As-Is services (add a service, retire one, merge one into another, re-home one to another network or provider) without changing As-Is, so later As-Is edits carry into every scenario; each change is one undo step, and a service a scenario adds counts on the classification banner.
